metadata.description: Claude Code plugins from One Good Idea.

plugins.name: checklist
plugins.description: A pane beside the chat that keeps a session’s follow-ups: Now, Up next, Proposed, and Done.

plugins.name: context-strip
plugins.description: A row above the prompt showing how full the session’s context window is, with the checklist’s summary beside it.

plugins.name: markdown-links
plugins.description: Keeps links between Markdown notes working everywhere: converts [[wikilinks]] to relative links, writes and checks links, and moves notes without breaking them.
